title: bug: daemon openProjectGit refusal misses worktree-scoped Git config
description: packages/moe-daemon/src/util/cachedPlanPaths.ts:134 refuses partialclone/promisor/core.worktree repos via `git config --local --includes --get-regexp`, but --local never reads $GIT_DIR/config.worktree, which Git applies to every command once extensions.worktreeConfig=true. So `git config --worktree remote.o.promisor true` (or core.worktree) passes the refusal, and per the code's own comment Git <2.44 ignores GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH. Same defect QA found in CQ-R09b (task-697fb2de19324ccb851defaf9f24043b, fixed there by dropping --local since system/global are env-masked; repro row E7 in scripts/tests/local-runner-snapshot.test.mjs).
definitionOfDone: openProjectGit's config refusal reads every unmasked scope (local, worktree, command line), and a test with extensions.worktreeConfig=true plus a --worktree promisor or core.worktree key is refused

implementationPlan.description:
Fix the refusal scope in packages/moe-daemon/src/util/cachedPlanPaths.ts, and pin its argv in cachedPlanPaths.test.ts (DoD 1).

- openProjectGit (line ~134): drop '--local'. The call becomes ['config', '--includes', '--get-regexp', '^(extensions\\.partialclone|remote\\..*\\.promisor|core\\.worktree)$'].
  - With no scope flag, Git reads every unmasked scope: local, worktree ($GIT_DIR/config.worktree, which Git applies once extensions.worktreeConfig=true) and the command line.
  - readOnlyGitEnv already masks system and global (GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null or NUL) and strips every inherited GIT_*, including GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS.
  - This is the same fix QA required in CQ-R09b's source-export.mjs (repro row E7 in scripts/tests/local-runner-snapshot.test.mjs).
- Update the comment above it to say this, and why --local is wrong: it never reads config.worktree. Keep the error text 'local Git config sets <key>; ...' unchanged, so the existing it.each rows pass unchanged.
- Exit 1 from `git config --get-regexp` with no match is already '' through runGit's config exit-1 rule; keep it.
- Error handling: unchanged. Any Git failure still rejects through failure(); a match still throws the refusal.
- In cachedPlanPaths.test.ts, add one row with the mocked runner: the config call's args deep-equal the exact array above, so '--local' is absent.
- Leave src/benchmarks/maintenanceWorkloads.ts alone. Its copy is a benchmark workload description of historical code, not live behavior.
implementationPlan.note: Dropped --local; added argv pin row. Many peer dirty paths noted, untouched.

implementationPlan.description:
Real-Git regression rows in a NEW packages/moe-daemon/src/util/cachedPlanPaths.git.test.ts (DoD 1).

It must be a separate file, because cachedPlanPaths.test.ts mocks node:child_process and ./gitExecutable.js for the whole file.
- Build fixtures as repositorySource.test.ts's fixture() does: a mkdtemp repo; execFileSync('git', ...) with env stripped of GIT_* plus GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 and GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL (/dev/null, or NUL on win32); `git init`, a user, and one commit. Remove the roots in afterEach.
- Call openProjectGit(root) with the REAL default runner.

Rows:
- A plain repository resolves, and its git('rev-parse --show-toplevel', ...) works.
- With `git config extensions.worktreeConfig true`:
  - `git config --worktree remote.o.promisor true` rejects with a message containing 'remote.o.promisor';
  - `git config --worktree core.worktree <root>` rejects with 'core.worktree'. Setting the repo root itself keeps the earlier toplevel check passing, so the CONFIG refusal is what fires;
  - an include.path in config.worktree, pointing at a file that sets remote.o.promisor, rejects (--includes).
- Control: the same promisor key in config.worktree WITHOUT extensions.worktreeConfig resolves. Git ignores that file then, so the check is no stricter than Git itself.

Mutation pin: putting '--local' back must fail the three worktree rows. Check it once in a scratch copy, and say so in your step note.

Error handling in the test: fixture git failures throw (execFileSync) and fail the row, never skip it.
implementationPlan.note: 6 real-Git rows incl. HOME .gitconfig masked control. Mutation (--local restored in scratch snapshot) failed the 3 worktree rows + argv pin.
Linux snapshot gate: 9 files, 559 tests passed, exit 0; owned files cmp-identical.

Reviewed: readOnlyGitEnv strips all GIT_* (PARAMETERS/COUNT/DIR) and masks system/global; HOME .gitconfig control row already added; -c args from readOnlyGitArgs don't match the regexp; message echoes only first token (key). No new findings; step-3 run stands (no code changed since).

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
Rejected these options:
- Adding '--worktree' as a second call. Two calls, and command-line scope would still be missed.
- Listing scopes explicitly with --show-scope. More parsing for the same answer.
Dropping --local, as CQ-R09b did, is the minimal fix: system and global are already env-masked.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- readOnlyGitEnv (cachedPlanPaths.ts:37) strips GIT_* and sets NOSYSTEM, GLOBAL=/dev/null or NUL, NO_LAZY_FETCH and TERMINAL_PROMPT=0.
- runGit treats config exit 1 as ''.
- openProjectGit's callers are requiredChecks.ts, planReuse.ts, planReuseState.ts and repositorySource.ts.
- cachedPlanPaths.test.ts mocks child_process for the whole file, so the real-Git rows need their own file.
- repositorySource.test.ts:113 fixture() is the real-Git fixture pattern.
planningNotes.risks:
- On WSL, daemon tests need the Linux snapshot gate.
- core.worktree pointing elsewhere is refused earlier by the toplevel check, so the row must point at the root itself to reach the config refusal.
- Windows CI: `git config --worktree` needs Git >= 2.20, which runners have.

reviewSummary: Reviewed completion commit 5f497451 (on moe/work-2026-10-24; recorded, pushed=true) via git show, not the dirty tree. Source diff is +6/-2 in cachedPlanPaths.ts: '--local' dropped from the openProjectGit config --get-regexp call, so Git reads local, config.worktree (once extensions.worktreeConfig=true) and command-line scopes. readOnlyGitEnv still strips every GIT_* and sets GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 and GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null (NUL on win32), so system and global stay masked. The -c args from readOnlyGitArgs (protocol.allow, safe.directory) do not match the regexp. The error text is unchanged and echoes only the key name. Tests: +9 in cachedPlanPaths.test.ts (argv deep-equal pin, no --local) and a new cachedPlanPaths.git.test.ts of 62 lines with 6 real-Git rows: plain repo; worktree promisor; worktree core.worktree; include.path via config.worktree; control with the extension off (resolves, as Git does); and HOME .gitconfig masked. Total commit code/test diff is about 75 LOC, well under 400. Re-ran the verification myself in a fresh Linux snapshot (git archive 5f497451, npm ci, node v24.21.0, env -i, NO_COLOR=1): `npx vitest run cachedPlanPaths requiredChecks planReuse repositorySource` gave 9 files / 559 tests passed, exit 0, with the three owned files cmp-identical to the worktree. Mutation probe: restoring '--local' in the scratch copy fails the argv pin and the 3 worktree rows (promisor, core.worktree, include.path) and leaves the plain, off-extension and HOME-masked rows green, so the tests bite. DoD 1 and DoD 2 are both met. Not verified: Windows runtime (NUL global mask path) and Git older than 2.43 (the sandbox has 2.43.0). The commit's Moe-Contested note on cachedPlanPaths.ts (task-3e5c59e3) did not leak any peer hunk into this diff. No ponytail-level complexity findings.
